10
Honhom fam ko
1 # 1 Ko 2.3 Me Paulo ara na menam Kristo dwoɔ a ɔdwoɔ ne n’ayamyɛ so metu mo foɔ, me a mewɔ mo nkyɛn a, meyɛ mmɔborɔfoɔ wɔ mo mu, nanso menni mo nkyɛn a, meyɛ mo ho kokoɔdurufoɔ. 2#2 Ko 10.11; 1 Ko 4.21 Na meresrɛ mo, na meba mo nkyɛn a, anhia sɛ mekyerɛ akokoɔduro a mahyɛ sɛ mede awerɛhyɛmu bɛsi me bo makyerɛ wɔ ebinom a wɔbu yɛn sɛ yɛnam honam fam no soɔ. 3Na yɛnam honam mu deɛ, nanso yɛntu ɔsa honam fam; 4#Efe 6.13-17 ɛfiri sɛ yɛn sa a yɛtuo no akodeɛ nyɛ honam mu deɛ, na mmom ɛyɛ den Nyankopɔn anim sɛ yɛde bɛdwiri abankɛseɛ na yɛadwiri adwene 5ne biribiara a ɛkorɔn a wɔma so de ne Nyankopɔn nimdeɛ di asie, na yɛafa adwene nyinaa dommum de ayɛ setie ama Kristo, 6na yɛasiesie yɛn ho sɛ, sɛ mo setie wie pɛ yɛ a, yɛbɛtɔ asoɔden nyinaa so were.
Paulo kasa ne ne nneyɛɛ mu ahoɔden
7Mohwɛ honam ani adeɛ anaa? Sɛ obi de ne ho to ne ho so sɛ ɔyɛ Kristo dea a, ma ɔno ara nnwene nso sɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔno yɛ Kristo dea no, sɛ nso yɛyɛ Kristo dea ne no. 8#2 Ko 12.6; 1 Ko 5.4-5 Na sɛ mehoahoa me ho boro so kakra wɔ tumi a Awurade de ama yɛn mo nkɔsoɔ, na ɛnyɛ mo dwirie nti no ho mpo a, m’ani renwu, 9na manyɛ sɛ deɛ mede nwoma mebɛyi mo hu. 10#2 Ko 10.1 Na wɔka sɛ: Ne nwoma no deɛ, emu yɛ duru, na ɛkura tumi, nanso ɔwɔ yɛn ntam a, ɔyɛ mmerɛ, na ɔkasa nso a, ahoɔden biara nnim. 11#2 Ko 13.2; 13.10 Ma onii no nhunu sɛ, sɛdeɛ yɛnni hɔ a yɛteɛ wɔ nwoma mu asɛm mu no, saa ara nso na yɛwɔ hɔ a yɛteɛ wɔ nneyɛɛ mu.
Adwuma a Paulo yɛ ma Korintofoɔ
12 # 2 Ko 3.1; 5.12 Na yɛnsi yɛn bo sɛ yɛbu yɛn ho fra wɔn a wɔyi wɔn ho ayɛ no mu bi, anaasɛ yɛde yɛn ho to wɔn ho, na mmom wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho susu wɔn ho, na wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ara ho no, wɔnnim nyansa. 13#Rom 12.3 Na yɛn deɛ, yɛrenhoahoa yɛn ho mma no ntra so, na mmom sɛdeɛ susuhoma a Onyankopɔn de asusu ama yɛn sɛ yɛbɛduru mo nkyɛn bi no teɛ no. 14Na yɛntwe yɛn mu ntra so sɛdeɛ yɛnnuru mo nkyɛn; ɛfiri sɛ yɛde Kristo asɛmpa no abɛduru mo nkyɛn nso. 15#Rom 15.20 Na yɛnhoahoa yɛn ho mma no ntra so wɔ ebinom adwuma mu, na yɛn ani da so sɛ, mo gyidie nyini a, yɛbɛyɛ mo mu kɛse aboro so, sɛdeɛ susuhoma no teɛ 16#Aso 19.21 ama yɛakɔka asɛmpa no wɔ mmeammea a ɛwɔ mo akyiri nohoa, na yɛamfa obi susuhoma so anhoahoa yɛn ho deɛ wɔawie dada no ho.
17 # Yer 9.23-24; 1 Ko 1.31 Na deɛ ɔhoahoa ne ho no, ma no nhoahoa ne ho wɔ Awurade mu; 18#1 Ko 4.5 ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ deɛ ɔyi ne ho ayɛ na ɔfata, na mmom deɛ Awurade yi no ayɛ a.

pageProps.chapterText:
Me Paulo ara na menam Kristo dwoɔ a ɔdwoɔ ne n’ayamyɛ so metu mo foɔ, me a mewɔ mo nkyɛn a, meyɛ mmɔborɔfoɔ wɔ mo mu, nanso menni mo nkyɛn a, meyɛ mo ho kokoɔdurufoɔ. Na meresrɛ mo, na meba mo nkyɛn a, anhia sɛ mekyerɛ akokoɔduro a mahyɛ sɛ mede awerɛhyɛmu bɛsi me bo makyerɛ wɔ ebinom a wɔbu yɛn sɛ yɛnam honam fam no soɔ. Na yɛnam honam mu deɛ, nanso yɛntu ɔsa honam fam; ɛfiri sɛ yɛn sa a yɛtuo no akodeɛ nyɛ honam mu deɛ, na mmom ɛyɛ den Nyankopɔn anim sɛ yɛde bɛdwiri abankɛseɛ na yɛadwiri adwene ne biribiara a ɛkorɔn a wɔma so de ne Nyankopɔn nimdeɛ di asie, na yɛafa adwene nyinaa dommum de ayɛ setie ama Kristo, na yɛasiesie yɛn ho sɛ, sɛ mo setie wie pɛ yɛ a, yɛbɛtɔ asoɔden nyinaa so were.

Mohwɛ honam ani adeɛ anaa? Sɛ obi de ne ho to ne ho so sɛ ɔyɛ Kristo dea a, ma ɔno ara nnwene nso sɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔno yɛ Kristo dea no, sɛ nso yɛyɛ Kristo dea ne no. Na sɛ mehoahoa me ho boro so kakra wɔ tumi a Awurade de ama yɛn mo nkɔsoɔ, na ɛnyɛ mo dwirie nti no ho mpo a, m’ani renwu, na manyɛ sɛ deɛ mede nwoma mebɛyi mo hu. Na wɔka sɛ: Ne nwoma no deɛ, emu yɛ duru, na ɛkura tumi, nanso ɔwɔ yɛn ntam a, ɔyɛ mmerɛ, na ɔkasa nso a, ahoɔden biara nnim. Ma onii no nhunu sɛ, sɛdeɛ yɛnni hɔ a yɛteɛ wɔ nwoma mu asɛm mu no, saa ara nso na yɛwɔ hɔ a yɛteɛ wɔ nneyɛɛ mu.

Na yɛnsi yɛn bo sɛ yɛbu yɛn ho fra wɔn a wɔyi wɔn ho ayɛ no mu bi, anaasɛ yɛde yɛn ho to wɔn ho, na mmom wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho susu wɔn ho, na wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ara ho no, wɔnnim nyansa. Na yɛn deɛ, yɛrenhoahoa yɛn ho mma no ntra so, na mmom sɛdeɛ susuhoma a Onyankopɔn de asusu ama yɛn sɛ yɛbɛduru mo nkyɛn bi no teɛ no. Na yɛntwe yɛn mu ntra so sɛdeɛ yɛnnuru mo nkyɛn; ɛfiri sɛ yɛde Kristo asɛmpa no abɛduru mo nkyɛn nso. Na yɛnhoahoa yɛn ho mma no ntra so wɔ ebinom adwuma mu, na yɛn ani da so sɛ, mo gyidie nyini a, yɛbɛyɛ mo mu kɛse aboro so, sɛdeɛ susuhoma no teɛ ama yɛakɔka asɛmpa no wɔ mmeammea a ɛwɔ mo akyiri nohoa, na yɛamfa obi susuhoma so anhoahoa yɛn ho deɛ wɔawie dada no ho.
Na deɛ ɔhoahoa ne ho no, ma no nhoahoa ne ho wɔ Awurade mu; ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ deɛ ɔyi ne ho ayɛ na ɔfata, na mmom deɛ Awurade yi no ayɛ a.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
